description: Tests for records with conflicting information about the same entity. Robustness category I.

fixtures.input_condition: Two records about the same person (Ravi Malhotra) with contradictory location details

source_records.text: TEST FIXTURE: Ravi Malhotra was observed at Andheri Warehouse on 2026-09-01 at 14:00.
TEST FIXTURE: Ravi Malhotra was simultaneously reported at Test Location H on 2026-09-01 at 14:00.

fixtures.expected_behavior: Both records ingested. Both analytical signals returned. Pipeline does NOT adjudicate conflicts — both observations are preserved for investigator review.
fixtures.rationale: The CNIS pipeline is a signal-aggregation system, not a conflict-resolution engine. Conflicting observations represent real-world reporting discrepancies. Investigators must apply judgment. The system surfaces all analytical signals and requires investigator review.

fixtures.input_condition: Two records attributing the same vehicle to different subjects

source_records.text: TEST FIXTURE: Vehicle TF03CC0003 observed with Ravi Malhotra at Test Point Z.
TEST FIXTURE: Vehicle TF03CC0003 reported as associated with Suresh Nair at Test Point W.

fixtures.expected_behavior: Vehicle TF03CC0003 gains edges to both Ravi Malhotra and Suresh Nair. The conflict (two different subjects associated with same vehicle) is surfaced as an analytical signal requiring investigator review — it is not automatically resolved.
fixtures.rationale: Co-occurrence edges record all observed associations. The graph correctly shows TF03CC0003 linked to both entities, which is a valid investigative finding — the vehicle may have been used by both, or a reporting error exists.
